en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.5860 - Ibn Faddal narrated from Ghalib ibn Uthman, from Shuayb Al-Aqarqufi, from Abu Abdullah Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as), peace be upon him, who said:
"Whoever controls himself in moments of desire, fear, craving, anger, and satisfaction, Allah (swt) will make his body forbidden to the Fire."
